about.title: Fowler Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Fowler is a small community wedged between Golden State Boulevard and SR-99, where households rely on everyday products — farm equipment, tools, vehicle parts, appliances, and consumer goods — without a second thought. When one of those products fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the injuries can be serious and the cause isn't always obvious right away. California law generally lets an injured person pursue a strict liability claim without having to prove the maker was careless, but building that case still takes work: identifying every company in the supply chain, preserving the product, and gathering records. We handle product liability claims directly for Fowler residents. Our team can review what happened, explain your options, and take on the investigation while you focus on recovering. There's no cost for a free consultation, and we only get paid if you recover.
commonInjuries: Burns from malfunctioning appliances or electronics
Crush or amputation injuries from farm or industrial equipment
Traumatic injuries from defective vehicle parts or tires
Chemical exposure or poisoning from mislabeled products
Lacerations from faulty tools or machinery
Injuries from children's products lacking adequate safety warnings

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Case
items.desc: California often allows injured people to recover without proving the manufacturer was negligent, focusing instead on whether the product itself was defective. Our team can help identify which type of defect applies to your situation.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable under California product liability law. We can investigate the full supply chain rather than settling for the first name on the box.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: Because the product itself is often the key piece of evidence, keeping it safe and unaltered after an injury can be critical. We can advise on preservation before evidence is lost or discarded.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Under California's strict liability approach, you generally need to show the product was defective and that it caused your injury, not that the company was negligent. Our team can evaluate which type of defect — design, manufacturing, or warning — fits your case.

items.question: What if the product broke on Golden State Boulevard or SR-99?
items.answer: Location matters less than the product itself, but where an incident happens, such as along Fowler's Golden State Boulevard or SR-99 corridor, can affect witnesses, records, and responding agencies. We can help gather any relevant local reports while the details are still fresh.

items.question: Is there any cost to get a free consultation?
items.answer: No. There's no cost for an initial consultation, and we generally work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. You can reach out to see if you have a case with nothing to lose.
